scope: Two new session movements; all 907 prior records and their assessments unchanged.

entries.observedAction: Official gymnastics human footage shows the front-view entry from floor support, both straight legs spread wide, the complete unsupported horizontal hold on straight arms, and a controlled exit to a foot-supported low push-up.
